title: multimodal_fusion_covid_19_code
summary: A research codebase for COVID-19 diagnosis experiments that fuse clinical and imaging data across three experimental scenarios. Its dataset balancing utilities use SDV's SingleTableMetadata and GaussianCopulaSynthesizer/CTGANSynthesizer to generate synthetic minority-class samples for class imbalance correction.
needs: CTGANSynthesizer import is present but call site not shown in evidence; only GaussianCopulaSynthesizer usage is confirmed.
